decisions.label: Acetone
decisions.description: A colorless, volatile, flammable organic solvent used as a fixative and dehydration agent for biological tissues.

verification.note: NCIT:C29807 Acetone; exact label match. Used as a tissue fixative in histology.

decisions.label: Alcohol
decisions.description: A volatile liquid that kills organisms by denaturing their proteins; used as a disinfectant and tissue fixative.

verification.note: NCIT:C2190 Alcohol; exact label match but definition is primarily pharmacological. As a fixative, 'Alcohol' typically refers to ethanol. Best available NCIT match.

decisions.label: Formaldehyde
decisions.description: A colorless gas readily soluble in water; formalin (10% formaldehyde solution) is widely used as a tissue fixative and preservative.

verification.note: NCIT:C29744 Formaldehyde; formalin is a 10% aqueous solution of formaldehyde. NCIT definition explicitly states 'formalin, a 10% solution of formaldehyde in water, is used as a disinfectant and to preserve biological specimens.' Best available NCIT match.

decisions.label: Glutaral
decisions.description: A water-soluble oily liquid containing two aldehyde groups, used as a disinfectant and as a fixative for biological tissues.

verification.note: NCIT:C80930 Glutaral; 'Glutaral' is the NCIT preferred label for glutaraldehyde. Definition explicitly mentions use as a fixative for biological tissues.

decisions.label: Saline
decisions.description: A solution of salt and water; saline usually refers to normal or physiological saline, which is an aqueous solution containing 0.9% sodium chloride.

verification.note: NCIT:C821 Saline; exact label match for physiological saline solution used in specimen collection.

decisions.label: 95% Ethyl Alcohol
decisions.description: An aqueous dilution of ethanol containing 95% ethanol by volume, which may be used as a solvent, disinfectant or fixative.

verification.note: NCIT:C185110 95% Ethyl Alcohol; label uses 'Ethyl Alcohol' vs 'Ethanol' and the definition explicitly includes use as a fixative. Best match for 95% Ethanol.

decisions.label: Carbodiimide
decisions.description: A group of reagents that crosslinks amines and carboxylates, used as a fixative and in peptide conjugation.

verification.note: NCIT:C185111 Carbodiimide; exact label match. Definition explicitly mentions use as a fixative.

decisions.label: N,N-Dimethylacetamide
decisions.description: A dipolar aprotic solvent and reagent used in the production of fibers and pharmaceuticals, and as a non-aldehyde fixative.

verification.note: NCIT:C29274 N,N-Dimethylacetamide; label has 'N,N-' prefix vs plain 'Dimethylacetamide'. Definition explicitly mentions use as a non-aldehyde fixative.

decisions.label: PAXgene Tissue System
decisions.description: A proprietary system comprised of a formalin-free tissue fixative and stabilizing reagent designed to preserve tissue structures without damaging biomolecules.

verification.note: NCIT:C185113 PAXgene Tissue System; label adds 'System' but is the correct NCIT term for the PAXgene Tissue fixative reagent used in biospecimen preservation.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier, exact match.

decisions.label: Carnoy's Solution
decisions.description: A denaturing fixative consisting of ethanol, chloroform and glacial acetic acid in a 6:3:1 ratio, particularly effective for the preservation of nuclei and in retaining glycogen.

verification.note: NCIT:C178534 Carnoy's Solution; exact label match.

decisions.label: Optimal Cutting Temperature Compound
decisions.description: A solution of water soluble glycols and resins that provide a specimen support matrix for cryostat sectioning at temperatures of -10 degrees C and below.

verification.note: NCIT:C63523 Optimal Cutting Temperature Compound; 'OCT media' is the common shorthand for the Optimal Cutting Temperature Compound, a cryosection embedding medium. The definition correctly describes the compound used for tissue cryosectioning.

decisions.label: RNALater
decisions.description: Trade name for an aqueous, non-toxic tissue storage reagent that rapidly permeates tissues to stabilize and protect cellular RNA.

verification.note: NCIT:C63348 RNALater; exact match for the RNA stabilization reagent used as a fixative/preservative. Label capitalizes 'L' differently but is the same product.

decisions.label: NP40 Lysis Buffer
decisions.description: A detergent-based cell lysis buffer suitable for total protein extraction that helps retain the protein structure and function for enzyme assays or immunoassays.

verification.note: NCIT:C178573 NP40 Lysis Buffer; exact label match.

decisions.label: Not Recorded
decisions.description: The information was not captured or stored.

verification.note: NCIT:C185193 Not Recorded; exact label match for a missing value reason indicating data was not captured.

decisions.label: p-Benzoquinone
decisions.description: A benzoquinone compound used as a tissue crosslinking fixative.

verification.note: NCIT:C95317 p-Benzoquinone; 'p-' is the standard chemical abbreviation for 'para-', so p-Benzoquinone and Para-benzoquinone are the same compound. NCIT has no definition for this term but the chemical identity is confirmed.

decisions.label: Buffer TCL
decisions.description: A proprietary buffer containing RNase inhibitors designed for cell lysis and the extraction and collection of mRNA from cell samples.

verification.note: NCIT:C178572 Buffer TCL; label word order inverted (Buffer TCL vs TCL Lysis Buffer) but is the same reagent — a proprietary buffer for cell lysis and mRNA extraction.

decisions.label: Biological Cryopreservation Medium
decisions.description: A serum- and protein-free cryopreservation medium for biological specimens that minimizes cellular damage following freezing and thawing.

verification.note: NCIT:C178539 Biological Cryopreservation Medium; CryoStor is a branded serum-free cryopreservation medium and falls within this NCIT class. The NCIT term is a generic class, not brand-specific. Best available match.

decisions.label: Other
decisions.description: Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.

verification.note: NCIT:C17649 Other; standard NCIT general qualifier, exact label match.

decisions.label: None
decisions.description: No person or thing, nobody, not any.

verification.note: NCIT:C41132 None; standard NCIT general qualifier, exact label match.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C17998 Unknown; standard NCIT qualifier, exact match.
